findings.title: The closed bootstrap protocol cannot convey the observed port before the version invocation needs it
findings.observation: The observer binds 127.0.0.1:port0. Both wrappers must READY and pass preflight before START_NATIVE/version. The fixed native environment includes ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL with the observed port, and NATIVE_START/version binds an envSha256. READY has no port. The only frame that exposes the selected port is ARMED, which is forbidden until after NATIVE_END/version. Host commands have exactly version/runId/seq/type, with no field to pass the selected port or resolved environment to the already-created client.
findings.reason: There is no permitted producer-to-consumer path for the dynamic port before its first required use. The final profile can record a value later but is not a defined bootstrap channel to the client. This affects whether the promised exact env and phase/identity evidence can be implemented, not just report presentation.
staticCounterexample: Observer chooses an arbitrary ephemeral port P and can emit READY only with the listed preflight fields.
Client READY and complete containment checks are required before version launch.
Version must spawn with the specified resolved ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and report its exact envSha256, but no allowed frame/command has communicated P.
Waiting for ARMED cannot resolve this: ARM_PORT is allowed only after that version invocation has ended.
Guessing/scanning a port, adding an undeclared channel/field, or silently changing the version environment is not the closed contract.
findings.requiredChange: Define one explicit bootstrap sequence and finite host-controlled transport for the observed port, then bind it to the resolved profile and per-phase env/argv digests. For example, expose the real bound port in the observer READY (or a specifically defined pre-version listening frame), let the host validate it and construct the client resolved configuration before its READY/version, and keep ARM_PORT solely as the later evidence-eligibility transition. Alternatively specify and validate separate version/port environments plus an explicit finite port delivery mechanism before START_PORT. Choose one normative solution; no need for both. A version phase with an implicit exception and no port delivery to the prompt phase would not close this.
closureCriteria: A reader can trace P from the actual observer bind to the exact client environment before each applicable spawn using only the declared protocol/configuration channels.
Specify the point at which the run-specific profile/consumed configuration is frozen and how later mutation is rejected; no implicit mutable profile-file channel.
A documentary bootstrap trace includes observer port discovery, client configuration and READY, containment PASS, version, ARM_PORT/ARMED and prompt launch in an achievable order.

Define deterministic rejection for missing/invalid/mismatched/substituted P, and a future controller-negative test proving zero native spawn when the required resolved input is unavailable. These remain future tests, not a runtime requirement for this documentary correction.
findings.confidence: HIGH for the textual dataflow gap; no implementation or exploit was executed
